purpose: Cut bounded subtractive features directly into one observed existing rigid static UC GLB rectangular-prism mesh, preserving exact supported material factors and revalidating topology and published GLB geometry.

properties.source_path: existing ordinary .glb creation outside protected live machine body
properties.path: distinct target .glb path outside protected live machine body
properties.specification: closed axm.mesh-precision-cutter/v0.2 recipe using round-through-hole or box-notch
properties.expected_source_sha256: optional exact lowercase SHA-256 binding, with optional sha256: prefix

contains: exact source GLB SHA-256 and source byte count
source closed edge-topology evidence before cutting
measured rectangular-prism recognition and volume evidence
cut recipe digest bound to exact source digest
output closed edge-topology evidence before publication

relationships: reads actual existing GLB triangles through UC's static geometry decoder before calculating a cut
reuses UC seam-weld topology evidence before and after surgery
reuses the v0.1 cutter geometry constructors for the supported cut shapes
reuses the existing deterministic surface-to-GLB publisher and validator
keeps source bytes separate from the new output and refuses in-place cutting
limitations: v0.2 proves the existing-mesh path on exactly one rigid static closed consistently oriented axis-aligned rectangular-prism primitive. General arbitrary-mesh boolean surgery remains unavailable.

Only principal-axis round through-holes and open box notches are supported. Rotated stock, multiple primitives/components, skins, animation, morphs, UVs, textures, tangents, vertex colours, joints and other extra vertex attributes are rejected rather than silently discarded.
Supported PBR colour/emissive factors must be exactly representable by the existing 8-bit colour surface grammar; unsupported material features are rejected.
Edge-manifold topology is checked, but self-intersection, visual quality, structural strength, real manufacturing behavior and host-engine import are not proven.

truth.basis: The exact source bytes, topology, measured stock, cut parameters, output topology, output digest and unsupported boundaries are explicit.

agency.basis: The caller chooses the existing source, output path, cut axis, location, shape, dimensions, kerf and replacement decision; no design intent is silently selected.

continuity.basis: The source is read-only, in-place mutation is rejected, output publication reuses UC atomic GLB behavior, and protected machine-body paths remain unavailable.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The cutter rejects unsupported source structure and material state, proves closed source topology and rectangular-prism scope before subtraction, then proves closed output topology and published GLB structure.
